body.name: Prespecified ordinal benefit-risk scoring rule
body.construction: Fix clinically interpretable efficacy score \(E(d)\), toxicity burden \(H(d)\), positive weights \(w_E,w_H\), and cutpoints \(c_j\) before unblinding. Set \(U_{\mathrm{BR}}(d)=w_EE(d)-w_HH(d)\) and \(Y(d)=\sum_{j=1}^{L-1}\mathbf 1\{U_{\mathrm{BR}}(d)\ge c_j\}\in\mathcal Y_L\).
